---
title: "Mid-term Survey — Skills & Methane Projects"
---

Update your **eight skill ratings (round 2)**, share your interests, and describe **where you want to focus your methane model**. Then open the **Class map** tab to browse classmates’ current skills and project ideas and choose potential group members.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
No sign-in needed. Your name and responses are visible to anyone who can access this page. Use a recognizable name so classmates can find you. Submit again with the same name to update your profile; only your latest mid-term response appears here. First-day responses are kept separate.
:::

```{=html}
<div id="eds-survey-wrap">
  <iframe id="eds-survey" src="survey/midterm_survey.html"
          title="ENV 730 Mid-term Skills and Methane Project Map"
          style="width:100%;border:0;border-radius:14px;min-height:1500px;overflow:hidden"
          loading="lazy"></iframe>
</div>
<script>
  // resize the embedded survey to its content so there is no inner scrollbar
  window.addEventListener('message', function (e) {
    if (e.source === document.getElementById('eds-survey').contentWindow && e.data && Number.isFinite(e.data.env730Height)) {
      var f = document.getElementById('eds-survey');
      if (f) f.style.height = (e.data.env730Height + 24) + 'px';
    }
  });
</script>
```
